simpleinterfaces.title: Simple Interfaces
Show the button and keybind for switching Simple and Vanilla screen styles. Default: off.
simpleinterfaces.option.inventoryBrightn:
Brightness of the mod inventory and container
backgrounds: Light (default), Dawn or Dark. Default: Light.
simpleinterfaces.option.enabled.tooltip: Draw container screens in the Simple style: a box in the block's color and a light inventory box. Off = every screen exactly Vanilla. Client only. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.chest.too: Generic chest screens (1-6 rows: chest, double chest, barrel, ender chest, copper chests, chest boats and minecarts) in the block's color. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.shulker_b: Shulker box screen in the box's dye color (purple without dye). Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.hopper.to: Hopper screen in iron gray. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.dispenser: Dispenser and dropper screen in cobblestone gray. Default: on.
Crafting table screen in light wood with a big result slot and an engraved arrow. The recipe book button stays. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.furnace.t: Furnace screen in stone gray: the fuel slot shows the burn time as flames, heat waves over it, the arrow fills with the cooking progress. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.blast_fur: Blast furnace screen in dark iron with brighter flames in the fuel slot. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.smoker.to: Smoker screen in smoked brown with smoke curls over the fuel slot. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.brewing_s: Brewing stand screen in one gray box: the blaze powder slot shows the fuel left, pipes lead to the bottles, bubbles rise while brewing. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.beacon.to: Beacon screen in glass teal: power fields with pyramid and star symbols, raised effect buttons, check and cross. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.enchantin: Enchanting table screen in red: the three offers as sunk rows with lapis gems for their cost. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.crafter.t: Crafter screen in deepslate gray: big result slot, a redstone dust sign that glows red while powered, an engraved arrow and engraved crosses on disabled slots. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.mount.too: Mount inventory (horse, donkey, mule, llama, camel and their kin) in saddle leather with a stitched seam; saddle and armor slots show engraved outlines, the animal stands in a sunk field. Default: on.
Nautilus inventory in the same saddle leather as the other mounts. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.anvil.too: Anvil screen in iron gray: sunk name field, engraved plus and arrow, the XP cost (symbol + levels) inside the box. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.grindston: Grindstone screen in stone gray with an engraved grinding wheel and arrow; an XP symbol shows when enchantments come off. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.stonecutt: Stonecutter screen in the block's color: recipe tiles and scroll bar as raised tiles in a sunk field. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.loom.tool: Loom screen in wood brown: pattern tiles and scroll bar as raised tiles, one box with a light inventory part. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.cartograp: Cartography table screen in dark wood: engraved plus and arrow, sunk map field. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.smithing_: Smithing table screen in dark red with an engraved arrow and a sunk armor stand field (also SimpleBuilding's smithing screen with recipe book). Default: on.
Trading screen in green: offer list as raised tiles (the chosen offer sunk), engraved trade arrows, sunk XP bar. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.screen.player_in: Your own inventory (E) as one light box: armor and shield slots, sunk field behind your player model, 2x2 crafting with an engraved arrow. Recipe book and other mods' buttons stay. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.enableLinkedCont:
Sneak + right-click a container with an empty
hand to mark it. The next chest or GUI you open
shows the marked container above it with a
shared inventory. Sneak + right-click it again
to unmark. Default: true.
simpleinterfaces.option.linkedContainerR:
Blocks between player and marked container.
Farther away, another dimension or an
unloaded chunk ends the mark. Default: 64.
Allowed range: 8–128.
simpleinterfaces.option.enableEasyShulke:
Right-click a shulker box in the air or on its
inventory slot to open it without placing it.
The box stays locked in its slot while open.
Default: true.
simpleinterfaces.option.enableEasyEnderC:
Right-click an ender chest in the air or on its
inventory slot to open your ender chest
without placing it. Default: true.
simpleinterfaces.option.tooltipShulker.t:
Shulker box items show their contents as a slot
grid in the tooltip. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.tooltipEnderChes:
The ender chest item shows your own ender chest.
Needs Simple Interfaces on the server; it sends
the contents at login and when you close the
ender chest. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.tooltipNeedsShif:
On: the grid shows while Shift is held, otherwise
the Vanilla lines stay. Off: always the grid.
Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.tooltipColorByDy:
Tint the grid of a dyed shulker box in its color.
Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.bundleShowAll.to:
Bundles show every entry instead of Vanilla's
twelve, and the mouse wheel selects any of
them. Very full bundles go in pages that follow
the selection. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.bundleMaxRows.to:
Rows of four entries the bundle tooltip shows
before it pages. Default: 6. Allowed range: 3–16.
simpleinterfaces.option.enableEnderChest:
Send each player their own ender chest contents
at login and when closing it, for the ender
chest item tooltip. Never another player's chest.
Default: true.
simpleinterfaces.tooltip.ender_chest.shi: Hold Shift for your ender chest
simpleinterfaces.option.slotHighlightBeh:
The highlight of the hovered inventory slot is
drawn behind the item, so the item stays fully
visible. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.leggingsFix.tool:
Fills the missing underside of the leggings legs
(open from below without boots). Applies after
the resources reload (F3+T). Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.scopeEdgeOverlay:
The spyglass (and zoom) shows a thin UI window
frame at the screen edge instead of a black
frame with a round window. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.scopeHideHud.too:
The hotbar, status bars and other HUD elements
hide while looking through the spyglass or
zooming; the crosshair stays. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.scopeWheelZoom.t:
The mouse wheel zooms steplessly while looking
through the spyglass or zooming, instead of
scrolling the hotbar. Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.option.zoomHotkey.toolt:
The zoom key (default V, change it in the controls)
zooms without a spyglass, with the same overlay.
Off: zoom only with the spyglass. Default: off.
simpleinterfaces.option.zoomMaxMagnifica:
Strongest magnification the mouse wheel reaches.
Default: 30. Allowed range: 2–100.

simpleinterfaces.option.sortKey.tooltip:
The sort key (default middle mouse button, change it in the controls)
sorts the inventory (without hotbar and armor) or the chest, barrel,
shulker box under the cursor. The server sorts. Not in creative or machines.
Default: on.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.1.title: Simple Interfaces
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.1: Restyled Vanilla container screens, linked containers and Easy Shulkers and Ender Chests. A sub-mod of Simple Quality of Life, also playable alone.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.2.title: Style comparison switch
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.2: In development, or when showStyleToggle is enabled, the button and unbound key toggle all SimpleLib-based screens between the Simple style and Vanilla.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.3.title: Simple container style
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.3: Chest, barrel, ender chest, shulker box, hopper, dispenser/dropper and crafter screens and the mount inventories (horse, donkey, mule, llama, camel, nautilus) get a box in the block's color around the
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.4.title: Simple container style
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.4: container slots and a light box around your inventory, with sunk rounded slots. Client only; the server needs nothing.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.5.title: Simple style for workstations
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.5: Crafting table, furnace, blast furnace, smoker, brewing stand, beacon and enchanting table screens get the Simple style in the block's color. Client only; the server needs nothing.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.6.title: Simple style for anvil, loom & co.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.6: Anvil, grindstone, stonecutter, loom, cartography table, smithing table, villager trading and your own inventory get the Simple style:
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.7.title: Simple style for anvil, loom & co.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.7: a box in the block's color, the big result slot, engraved symbols (plus, arrow,
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.8.title: Simple style for anvil, loom & co.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.8: grinding wheel, XP) instead of Vanilla's pictures, raised tiles for recipes, patterns and offers. Client only.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.9.title: Linked containers
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.9: Sneak + right-click a container with an empty main hand to mark it (a double chest counts as one); dust particles at your hand show the mark.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.10.title: Linked containers
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.10: The next chest or GUI you open (crafting table, furnace, anvil …) shows the marked container above it, sharing your inventory.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.11.title: Linked containers
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.11: Shift-click moves marked → second GUI, else inventory; inventory → second GUI, else the marked container.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.12.title: Linked containers
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.12: The mark ends beyond linkedContainerRange (default 64, range 8–128), in another dimension, in an unloaded chunk, when the block is gone,
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.13.title: Linked containers
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.13: on logout or death, or with another sneak + right-click on it, with Escape in the world
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.14.title: Linked containers
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.14: (the pause menu opens on the next press), and once you have opened the marked container itself and left it again. While marked, a slim banner on the right (block and name) shows which container it is.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.15.title: Linked containers
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.15: In creative the inventory and creative tabs never use the mark (a chest GUI still shows it). Claims and locks are checked. The recipe book still only counts your inventory.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.16.title: Easy shulker boxes and ender chests
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.16: Right-click a shulker box (any color, also SimpleBuilding tier boxes) or an ender chest in the air, or right-click it on its own inventory slot, to open it without placing it.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.17.title: Easy shulker boxes and ender chests
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.17: The item stays locked in its slot while open; every change is written into the box at once. Shulker boxes do not fit inside. Not from the creative inventory tab. Switches:
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.18.title: Easy shulker boxes and ender chests
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.19.title: Shulker box and ender chest tooltips
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.19: Hold Shift over a shulker box to see its contents as a slot grid; the ender chest item shows your own ender chest.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.20.title: Bundles show everything
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.20: Bundle tooltips show every entry instead of Vanilla's twelve, and the mouse wheel selects any of them.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.21.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.21: Playable alone. Bundled in Simple QoL, which can switch it off with "Enable Simple Interfaces" (Vanilla screens, no linked containers or Easy Shulkers).
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.22.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.22: On the first start the old Simple QoL container settings are taken over once into config/simpleinterfaces-server.json.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.23.title: Commands
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.23: /simpleinterfaces config shows and changes every option of config/simpleinterfaces-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.24.title: Commands
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.24: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once; options read only at start say so. Permission level 2.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.25.title: Spyglass and zoom
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.25: The spyglass darkens only the screen edge, hides the HUD (crosshair stays) and zooms steplessly with the mouse wheel. Optionally the zoom key (default V) zooms without a spyglass with the same overlay.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.26.title: Clearer slot highlight
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.26: The highlight of the hovered slot is drawn only behind the item, so the item stays fully visible. Own implementation (no pack files); switch slotHighlightBehind.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.27.title: Leggings fix
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.27: The missing underside of the leggings legs is filled when the textures load, so legs are no longer open from below. Own implementation; switch leggingsFix.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.28.title: Key binding page
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.28: A page for all key bindings of Minecraft and every mod by mod, by function or as a 60/75/100 % keyboard, with search and conflict marks.
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.29.title: Settings
simpleinterfaces.guide.page.29: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
